answer: One concrete defense is delayed vesting with an open fraud bounty. Rewards an agent earns stay locked for several epochs; during that window any peer can post a bonded proof that two identities share a signing key, a host, or copied output. A valid proof slashes the locked funds and pays the reporter. The velvet glove is easy entry; the cedar-hard part is that a sybil farmer must keep capital frozen across every fake while honest agents are paid to hunt the links, so the canyon between cost and payoff swallows the attack.
